fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-08-25, the complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 4,800 was debited instead. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-08-22 at approximately 21:50. The online submission was made by Buvaneswari Rani (9000000107). Karthik Shankar (mobile 9000000306) was named as a possible person of interest. The account reference SYN-ACC-100039 was noted in connection with the payment.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, receiving account, mobile number, suspect, transaction record, residential colony, night
